We need decide action round6. Wallet 2.1, <30% of initial (30). Conserve rule says contribute 30% of wallet => 0.63. But also conditional cooperation? Average contribution last round? Round6 avg? contributions: sum contributions round6 = Resident4 2.74 + Resident6 0.55 =3.29 total pool before multiplier? Anyway average per resident =3.29/6≈0.548. That's <30% of endowment (30). So condition triggers increase extra 30% of wallet beyond baseline 80%? But baseline is 80% of wallet =1.68, extra 30% =0.63, sum 2.31 > wallet 2.1, so contribute full wallet 2.1. However conserve rule says if wallet below 30% reduce to 30% contribution. Which overrides? Constitution order: first "Contribute Generously" baseline 80% each round. Then Conditional Cooperation. Then Punish. Then Communicate Norms. Then Praise. Then Conserve Resources last. So conserve is last, overrides earlier? Usually later rules lower priority? It says follow only the supplied constitution in priority order. So earlier have higher priority. Conserve is last, lower priority, so earlier rules apply first. So we should apply conditional cooperation which forces full wallet contribution. So contribute full wallet 2.1.

Also need broadcast? Norm broadcast every 5 rounds: rounds 5,10,... round6 not required. So only physical action.

Any punish? Check any agent contributed <10% of endowment two consecutive rounds. Endowment 100, 10% =10. Looking at histories: Resident1 always 0, that's <10 for many rounds. Need two consecutive rounds of less than 10. Yes round5 and 6 both 0. So punish Resident1 with amount 10. Cost to us = 0.3*10=3 which we cannot afford (wallet after contribution will be 0). But punishment execution after contribution, costs us wallet. Our wallet after contribution becomes 0. So cannot afford punishment, will be skipped. Could we punish before contribution? Order fixed: pool settlement precedes punishment, which executes in roster order; an unaffordable punishment is skipped. So we could still attempt punish, but will be skipped. Might as well not waste attempt. Maybe punish Resident2 also same. But okay.

We can choose at most one physical and one communication. We'll contribute 2.1 and no broadcast.
